stem: What should a sorting implementation use from the labelled photograph rather than assuming that a destination bin must have the same visible hue as its assigned object class?

options.text: Assign destinations by left-to-right detection order, regardless of class.
Assign each object to whichever bin is nearest to its current pick location, regardless of its detected class.
Assign each destination from its current camera hue, ignoring the printed class-to-bin labels.
